text:
Date: The excavation's final season closed on 14 September 2019.
Named person: Tomas Adeyemi-Roth, site registrar for the Maridun Heritage Authority, confirmed Dr. Lindqvist as director of the dig.
Figure: The team recovered 1,284 catalogued artifacts across 11 trenches.
Document/event: The report rests on the Authority's Final Excavation Summary, released at its annual symposium in Valderra.
